candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: Multiple character errors: 遺刻する for 遅刻する, 寄（きょく）for 客（きゃく）, 違う/気を違う for 遣う/気を遣う, 訳く for 訊く, ～かわない for ～かねない, （けいけんする）for （けいけん）. Numbering badly corrupted (留学/誕生日/遣う mislabeled ②③, お礼 given a '4' it doesn't have). Stray/unbalanced bold markers, messy layout.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Very accurate: 遅刻, 客, 遣う, 訊く, ～かねない all correct; numbering (1/(2)/(3) distinctions) preserved. Minor issues: 不十分な reading given as（ふじゅうぶんな）where image shows（ふじゅうぶん）; furigana repositioned inline (履修(りしゅう)する) rather than trailing as in image.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: All characters and readings match the image, including 遣う, 訊く, ～かねない, （けいけん）, （ふじゅうぶん）. Furigana kept in original trailing position. Nesting of sub-numbered items (e.g. 1 留学する under item 3) is slightly artificial but numbering values are correct; お礼 correctly unnumbered.

rationale: C is essentially error-free on characters and readings and invents nothing, with only mildly artificial list nesting, so it ranks first. B is nearly as good and complete but adds な to the reading of 不十分な and restructures furigana placement, ranking second. A contains numerous OCR-style kanji errors (遺刻, 寄/きょく, 違う for 遣う, 訳く, ～かわない), corrupted item numbering, and messy bold formatting, placing it clearly last.
